$comment: What the example decks measure, scored by the same harness that scores a cold run and compiled from examples/*.deck.json by baseline.mjs, so nothing has to be built first. These are hand-authored decks, so the harness is only trustworthy if it says where they stand: where one sits under a floor (`misses`), that is a finding about the deck rather than a reason to move the bar. test_cold_run.py measures them again live; `node evals/cold-run/baseline.mjs --stamp` rewrites this record with the weight.json it was taken under.
